description: Land Titile Settlement Department -  Amendment  - Thalapitiya, Four Gravets D/S Division, Galle District - Cad. Map No. 810027
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration amendments under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains multiple entries detailing specific amendments to land parcel records, including changes to ownership details, mortgage encumbrances, land extents, village names, and other property-related particulars. The content is published in "PART III - LANDS" and focuses entirely on land and property matters, making it a clear example of a Land Gazette (Type 4).
